Without that explicit review contract, why-this-week, one substantive Late Breaking home, reader-facing Watchlist semantics and removal of pipeline-management/TODO prose can depend on reviewer memory.

Deterministic helpers may catch crisp leakage patterns, but nuanced Weekly editorial judgment remains agent-owned and must not pollute generic Core semantics.
actual_behavior: The canonical Issue Prevention Checklist now contains a Weekly overlay for why-this-issue, Late Breaking, Watchlist and carry-over semantics, and the agent-first bootstrap requires applicable ChatGPT editorial/research review before advancing. Semantic review remains Weekly/Profile-owned rather than a generic deterministic validator.
improvement_action: Implemented by WU-012D/F as a mandatory Weekly agent review overlay; no brittle semantic validator is required for open-ended prose judgment.
